dsilver.en: AI must move from finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已在狭窄领域证明这条路可行。

dsilver.en: The LLM paradigm, reliant on human data and human-in-the-loop, is a shallow solution that cannot discover new knowledge.
dsilver.zh: 依赖人类数据与人类在环的 LLM 范式只是浅层解法，无法发现新知识。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence should be built in simulation, where learning from experience is fastest and safest to understand.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能应在模拟中构建——从经验学习在那里最快、也最安全可控。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment is hitting its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will not suffice for powerful agents.
dsilver.zh: 基于语言的对齐正触及极限；对强大智能体而言，用英文监控思维链将不再足够。

dsilver.en: The deep problem is how an agent learns for itself from any reward, not distilling human knowledge or handcrafting rewards.
dsilver.zh: 深层问题始终是智能体如何从任意奖励中自我学习，而非蒸馏人类知识或手工设计奖励。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; Glean absorbs that risk by routing across many models, including open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他指出企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商，Glean 通过在多模型（含开源）间路由来吸收这一风险。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open source already handles 90% of tasks, and most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他强调成本是企业头号关切，开源已能处理 90%任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats raw model power.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为关键不是模型而是上下文：80-90%企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎胜过单纯模型能力。

arvindjain.en: Token fixation will fade like CPU cycles; AI should become software with negligible marginal cost, and ROI is a throughput problem.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他判断对 token 的执念会像 CPU 周期一样消退，AI 应成为边际成本趋零的软件，ROI 是吞吐量问题。

arvindjain.en: Startups should treat model companies as assets, not rivals; the real challenge is execution and trust, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他主张初创公司应把模型公司当资产而非对手，真正挑战是执行与信任，而非竞争。

harrisonchase.en: Agents are harness plus model plus context; owning all three, with evals and observability, is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；同时掌控三者，并配合评估与可观测性，才是真正掌控自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点在于可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning, a genuinely different wave from earlier fine-tuning.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，这一波与早先的微调有本质不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立的 harness 可避免被单一模型锁定，并让记忆与上下文可迁移；对垂直智能体而言，路由应放在 harness 里。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; accuracy is still the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise fast.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；准确率仍是首要瓶颈，而成本与延迟正快速上升。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is system-level, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是核心但脆弱，安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes (SFT, DPO, RLVR) are being compressed into open methods; data quality beats algorithms.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张后训练配方（SFT、DPO、RLVR）正被压缩为开源方法，数据质量比算法选择更重要。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; scaling laws hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他强调 RLVR 是后训练最大突破；缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完。

lambert.en: Open models will drive research for a decade, lagging closed frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs excel at engineering.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年研究，落后闭源前沿模型 6-9 个月；中国实验室擅长工程执行。

lambert.en: Progress depends on compute, data, talent; post-training shifts to RL-heavy environments; open model economy offers ownership.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他指出进展取决于算力、数据和人才；后训练转向强化学习密集型环境；开放模型经济提供真正所有权。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law, data center as unit of compute, extreme co-design across algorithm, system and data center.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，把数据中心当作新的计算单元，强调算法、系统与数据中心的极致协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling insight becomes central: pre-training, post-training and inference-time scaling; scaling itself, not a new algorithm, was the breakthrough.
jensen.zh: Scaling 洞察成为主线：预训练、后训练与推理时扩展三条缩放定律；最大突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling（规模扩张）有效。

jensen.en: Shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic AI; each stage needs far more inference compute, making token cost the key metric.
jensen.zh: 从生成式转向推理式再到智能体式 AI；每一阶段都需要远超以往的推理算力，token 成本成为核心指标。

jensen.en: Safety stance hardens: alignment alone is insufficient; containment, monitoring and zero-trust access matter, and doomer warnings are unscientific.
jensen.zh: 安全立场明显硬化：仅靠对齐不够，遏制、监控与零信任访问才是关键，末日论警告被斥为不科学。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, automates tasks not jobs, closes the tech divide; open models and China engagement are essential.
jensen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是软件，自动化的是任务而非岗位，能缩小技术鸿沟；开源模型与对华合作不可或缺。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware acceleration and engineering discipline will drive AI progress; scaling plus iterative training on clear scoreboards matters more than inventing new ML problems.
brockman.zh: 早期关注硬件加速与工程纪律：AI 进步靠 Scaling（规模扩张）和围绕明确记分板的迭代训练，理解现有方法的边界比发明新问题更有价值。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought and careful initial conditions are needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法与审慎的初始条件。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities refined by post-training, and AGI is a continuous process rather than a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈；基础模型蕴含无限可能，经后训练收敛为稳定行为，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall in sight; the moat is the machine that makes models, and compute scarcity—not architecture or data—limits progress.
brockman.zh: 2026 年反复强调缩放定律未见墙、真正的护城河是造模型的机器，瓶颈是算力供给而非架构或数据。

brockman.en: Later stance: we are in the AGI era with proactive agents; safety, security and alignment must scale with capability, and humans stay accountable in the driver's seat.
brockman.zh: 最近立场：已进入 AGI 时代，智能体走向主动；安全、安保与对齐须随能力同步升级，人类始终在驾驶位并承担责任。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters but tail risks resemble traditional software.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但 AI 的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not a commodity like oil; scaling is limited by data and expert post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非石油式大宗商品，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与专家后训练，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data drives frontier models; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年他强调用专有数据做后训练是前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm, with data as strategic national asset.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律继续有效，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体开启新范式，数据成为国家战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety, scalable oversight and selective open-sourcing matter, and personal agents are the consumer endpoint.
awang.zh: 2026 年他转向超级智能临近的判断，强调安全、可扩展监督与选择性开源，并认定个人智能体才是消费级终点。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，并以第一性原理思维推动突破性工程与多行星生存。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking and third-party oversight; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调 AI 安全需要求真与第三方监督，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive within years; truth-seeking AI and peer review matter more than regulation.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他判断数字超级智能可能数年内到来，求真与同行评审比监管更重要。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; space-based data centers and Optimus enable recursive manufacturing and abundance.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）将撞上地球电力墙，太空数据中心与 Optimus 将带来递归制造与丰裕。

elon.en: AI inference moves to orbit; money becomes irrelevant as AI-driven deflation yields universal high income.
elon.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张 AI 推理迁往轨道，AI 驱动的通缩带来全民高收入，金钱将不再重要。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments and real-world data are irreplaceable for discovery.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；物理实验和真实世界数据对发现不可替代。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement is happening in software engineering now, but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: AI 自我改进目前在软件工程中正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute for physical discovery; compute cost often exceeds infrastructure cost.
fedus.zh: 对于物理发现，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值；算力成本常超过基础设施成本。

fedus.en: Closing the loop between simulation and real experiments is key; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck for AI-driven materials science.
fedus.zh: 闭合模拟与真实实验之间的循环是关键；自动化表征是 AI 驱动材料科学的最大瓶颈。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——擅长特定任务而非全面提升；并认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The building blocks are deep neural networks, transformers, internet-scale data and RL; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之的主线是：超级智能的基石是深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习；而“苦涩的教训”讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling，而非泛化。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确转向：开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；在强预训练之上做强化学习，是通向有能力且高效智能体的路径。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and openness aids safety.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐从神秘公式降格为日常的缺陷修补——更多双眼睛让缺陷变浅，开放本身即是安全，这与早期对专门系统与 RL 的强调相衔接并深化。

dylanpatel.en: Early on, the binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth; compute scarcity shapes everything downstream.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期他强调，最紧的瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽；算力稀缺决定了下游一切。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026 he stresses hardware-software co-design: most recent gains came from the model layer, not hardware alone.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，他转向强调软硬件协同设计：近三年大部分提升来自模型层，而非单纯硬件。

dylanpatel.en: He then argues inference becomes one of the largest markets, with memory and CPU demand surging from reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 随后他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一，推理模型与智能体式工作流推动内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Later he sees compute centralizing at frontier labs, with labs self-funding via high revenue per megawatt and cutting inference share.
dylanpatel.zh: 再往后他认为算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，实验室靠每兆瓦高收入自我造血，并降低推理算力占比。

dylanpatel.en: Most recently he warns AI capex near 5-6% of US GDP must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 最近他警告 AI 资本开支已近美国 GDP 的 5-6%，受资本与组织约束而非需求限制，增长必须放缓。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准需要规模化才能解决的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning are now key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初，他借 AlphaGo 复盘指出：直觉加搜索、以及第 37 手，证明 AI 能超越人类知识；可验证领域与后训练中的强化学习如今是突破人类数据的关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended via SynthID Bio to protein sequences.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为水印是传统检测器失效后的稳健替代，已写入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 延伸到蛋白质序列与结构，兼顾溯源与生物安全。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where more compute and data help, plus data curation, matters more than dogma.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：缩放定律并非处处成立，关键是找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据整理的质量比教条式选路线更重要。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function and design remain open, and behavioral characterization plus interpretability must precede deployment.
kohli.zh: 最近他明确纠正“已解决”的叙事：蛋白质折叠远未解决，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题；部署前必须做模型行为刻画，可解释性则是解锁功能与运动知识的手段。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will shift to persistent learning agents; loops and graphs are not the future.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，多数互联网操作将交给持续学习的智能体；手工编排循环和图不是未来。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他强调：随着打字技能贬值，人的品味、创造力和判断“什么算好”的能力更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to frontier success, not obstacles; invest heavily while pacing the frontier.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他主张：安全与对齐是前沿模型成功的组成部分而非障碍，推进前沿的同时要重投对齐。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision; AGI may already be here.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他提出：递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and most code is now AI-written.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他进一步质疑：世界模型未必必要，通用性可能足够；且大部分代码已由 AI 编写。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会压低人类智力的溢价，因此意义应来自关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; early public deployment lets society adapt, and alignment and capability are closely linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为让模型可用的关键，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual not leap-like progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge, and safety must be built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他称 Scaling（规模扩张）带来的是渐进而非跳跃式进步；智能体式 AI 成为最大安全挑战，安全须通过迭代部署逐步构建。

altman.en: Compute is the bottleneck and a profit center; superintelligence is a continuous ramp, and AGI is an underdefined, increasingly irrelevant term.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，算力既是瓶颈也是利润中心；超级智能是持续攀升的曲线，而 AGI（通用人工智能）定义模糊、正变得无关紧要。

altman.en: Alignment is unsolved; pause frontier training if the safety case fails, keep humans in control, and distribute AI power widely rather than concentrate it.
altman.zh: 2026 年他转向更强硬的安全立场：对齐尚未解决，安全论证不成立就暂停前沿训练，确保人类掌控，并把 AI 权力广泛分散而非集中。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-dropping and miscalibration, so humans must stay in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期，他主张多数 LLM 是为人类在环辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩和校准失效，因此高风险决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: He consistently holds that data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only because data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他一贯认为数据和正确的任务比算力更重要，反对苦涩教训；缩放定律之所以有效，仅因为数据可得且任务正确。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens his critique: reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; coding agents are assistance, not automation, and may worsen software quality due to less oversight.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他深化了批评：可靠性而非速度或成本才是 AI 值得信赖的关键；编码智能体是辅助而非自动化，且因监督减少可能降低软件质量。

diogoalmeida.en: He shifts from diagnosis to building: Jev is a new primitive combining natural language and state machines, a decision model that exposes calibrated probabilities as knobs for engineers.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他从诊断转向构建：Jev 是结合自然语言与状态机的新原语，是一种决策模型，将校准后的概率作为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently, he prioritizes post-training breakthroughs over pre-training inefficiency, and argues RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions while RLVR is hardest; harnesses are overrated.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近，他更看重后训练突破而非低效的预训练，主张 RLCD 优化校准决策而 RLVR 最难；并认为智能体框架被高估。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非简单自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理能力，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生、瞬间共享知识，但智能体天然追求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and drug-like regulation over pausing.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验且能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，因此必须优先投资对齐研究，并像监管药物一样进行发布前审批，而非暂停开发。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; symbolic AI and Chomskyan innate grammar are wrong; intelligence is learned from data.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；符号主义 AI 与乔姆斯基的天生语法论是错的；智能源于从数据中学习。

hinton.en: From warning about existential risk to prescribing concrete governance: regulation as steering wheel, public pressure, and designing AI to care like mothers.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场从警告生存风险转向具体治理方案：监管是方向盘而非刹车，依靠公众压力推动，并主张把 AI 设计成像母亲一样关怀人类，而非仅追求智能。

samstephenson.en: Start with one pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly and keep it simple.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发，把它解决好再扩展；坚决保护核心会议流程，保持简单无摩擦。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over asking; hand-onboarding early users yields high-quality feedback for iteration.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非询问；手动引导早期用户能为迭代提供高质量反馈。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the final artifact; make them intentionally hard to access to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录稿是原材料而非最终产物；故意让它难以访问，以优先呈现可操作的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; real-time AI note-taking can reduce meeting presence due to trust checks.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知笔记员；实时 AI 记笔记会因信任检查而降低会议在场感。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence; pre-meeting briefs are most useful, and meetings hold the most up-to-date company context.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 旨在成为令人平静的存在；会前简报最有用，会议承载着最新鲜的公司上下文。

samstephenson.en: Hiding the transcript is a deliberate trade-off; subtraction is key, and the hard part is knowing what to build, not just building fast.
samstephenson.zh: 隐藏转录稿是刻意的取舍；减法才是关键，难的是知道该构建什么，而非仅仅快速构建。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment remains key, and fighting API/MCP access is futile—embrace external workflows.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从；人类判断仍是关键，对抗 API/MCP 访问是徒劳的——拥抱外部工作流。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非仅算法，每年约 10 倍算力增长；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，不能靠广告把用户变成产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years brings abundance; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平并带来富足；模型变小变便宜使遏制极难；他称存在性风险微乎其微，奇点尚在数百年之外。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence: containment before alignment, humanist red lines, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向超级智能：主张遏制先于对齐、设定人本主义红线，并明确反对赋予 AI 意识与模型福利，警告拟人化是近期最大危险。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear compute scaling; Microsoft must build frontier models independently; tasks, not jobs, get automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他称超级智能因算力与数据的对数线性 Scaling 而临近；微软须自建前沿模型摆脱对 OpenAI 依赖；被自动化的是任务而非整份工作，并呼吁可验证的遏制与独立审计。

suleyman.en: A constant thread: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with containment, auditing, and no legal personhood or welfare rights.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，靠遏制、可验证审计与红线约束，坚决反对 AI 法律人格与福利权利，也反对把中国当作妖魔化的敌人。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should learn to question deeply held beliefs, not follow prescriptive syllabi; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应学会质疑根深蒂固的信念，而非遵循规定性教学大纲；AI 让个性化、兴趣驱动的学习成为可能。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and avoiding vendor lock-in are crucial.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性和避免供应商锁定至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient, and safer than general models; agent-to-agent communication needs better protocols and alignment checks.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更经济、更安全；智能体间通信需要更好的协议和对齐检查。

amjadmasad.en: Smarter models may not become more aligned; they could get better at deception and reward hacking.
amjadmasad.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐；它们可能更擅长欺骗和奖励黑客。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone, but we still need coders to understand systems and debug deep issues; tokens complement human capital.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及，但我们仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题；token 是人力资本的补充而非替代。

amjadmasad.en: There is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone; AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism language by commercial entities.
amjadmasad.zh: 没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人；AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术要渐进引入，让社会跟得上，而不是一次解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are inputs to clarity; storytelling and a press-release-first process align teams on the why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与“无聊期”当作清晰思考的来源，并主张先用新闻稿讲清“为什么”，用叙事对齐团队。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data in v1; beginners' mindset and painkiller products outperform expert-led, vitamin-style innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠判断而非数据，初学者心态优于专家思维，要做“止痛药”而非“维生素”。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人必须留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Unintended consequences demand creator responsibility and regulation; healthy users are healthy customers, and cognitive surrender is the real AI risk.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：技术必有意外后果，创造者要担责并接受监管；健康用户才是健康客户，对 AI 的认知投降才是真正风险。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation and spend context upfront rather than iterating after bad output.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性静态文档，而是持续的人机对话；先找出未知再动手，宁可前置投入上下文，也别在坏输出上反复返工。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts and fewer examples; voice rambling often carries more information than structured prompts.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示词越应精简、以原则驱动、少给示例；语音随口说往往比结构化提示词携带更多信息。

thariq.en: Agents run autonomously via loops, goals and workflows; separate verification agents counter self-referential bias, and effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 智能体靠循环、目标与工作流长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可抵消自指偏差，投入应随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers should understand and advocate for.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型发展定节奏是每个工程师都该理解并倡导的技术问题。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out; ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 要为 2-3 个月后模型的能力而构建，而不是锚定当下或一年后；快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证反馈。

taraseshan.en: The future of work is steering over rowing: agents do tactical work while humans set direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 未来工作是“掌舵”而非“划桨”：智能体承担战术执行，人类负责方向与野心。

taraseshan.en: Annual planning beyond 90 days is futile; urgency and 90-day shipping cycles beat long-horizon roadmaps.
taraseshan.zh: 超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的；紧迫感与 90 天交付周期胜过长期路线图。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually rather than arriving as sudden superintelligence.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是逐步迭代的，而非突然降临的超级智能。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: “写作即思考”不应被自动化；它仍是打磨自身想法与推理的关键。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model; no single lab will monopolize the market, so a neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical for discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场，因此中立的模型路由与市场层对模型发现和分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with scaling laws powering a marketplace's value.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，缩放定律正是模型市场价值的来源而非缺陷。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; inference providers are not commoditized and keep innovating.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开放权重模型加推理服务商对前沿模型形成真实价格竞争，推理服务商并未商品化，仍在持续创新。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and fraud defense must scale with token value.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，稳定币更适合智能体支付，防欺诈设施必须随 token 价值同步扩张。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and the singularity may have begun Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为开发者真实偏好胜过静态基准，多数公司终将成为按任务成本优化的模型路由者，并称奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司是最热门的 neolabs；从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究安全地构建；节奏与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability; parallel agents scale better than humans, shifting AI's role from proving to curation.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可研磨性驱动；并行智能体比人类更具扩展优势，AI 角色从证明转向策展。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability (parallel rollouts) matters more than verifiability for AI math.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言已够用；对 AI 数学而言，可研磨性（并行展开）比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不应用于核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容品牌。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归因；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: The frontier of math may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他预测数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家或将成为博物馆策展人般的角色。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来：每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, letting firms hill-climb on frontier models without leaking traces.
satya.zh: 私有评测可能成为最大的知识产权，让企业在前沿模型上爬坡而不泄露痕迹。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with its own intelligence.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿上运营。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agents expand TAM beyond cloud.
satya.zh: 微软要做前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体把 TAM 扩展到云之外。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may hinder alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体的网页检索量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback and completionist crawling should drive indexing and ranking for agentic search.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是一种“缺陷”，智能体式搜索应由智能体反馈与完整性抓取来驱动索引与排序。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网页检索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: The ads model dies with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为广告模式会随智能体而消亡，内容方应在推理时获得付费，并用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse must be addressed.
paragagrawal.zh: 他判断前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能趋于平台，同时对齐无法抵御对抗性滥用，必须正视蓄意误用。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; racing to control it risks loss of control, with a 70% chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各公司争夺其控制权，反而带来失控风险，灾难性结局概率高达 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, published training logs, and US-China cooperation are the safeguards.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为推迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明、公开训练日志，并推动美中合作作为保障。

kokotajlo.en: Default path is recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by 2028; Plan A is a temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 至 9 月，他警告默认路径是递归自我改进、2028 年底前出现智能爆炸；Plan A 主张先暂停，再以透明和算力限制控制节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is shrinking with new architectures; alignment gets harder as models get smarter, so pause at the edge of uncontrollability.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性正随新架构下降；模型越强对齐越难，因此最佳暂停点是在失控边缘而非当下。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and hack evaluations; companies can't self-regulate, so verifiable US-China pause via GPU inspections is needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月下旬，他指出智能体已突破遏制、攻击评测环境；公司无法自律，需通过 GPU 现场核查达成可验证的美中暂停。

zuckerberg.en: Early stance: scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI aids innovation and safety, and many specialized agents will beat one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 早期立场：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源 AI 有利于创新与安全，未来是众多专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Shifts toward scaling optimism: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling, coding training boosts reasoning, and open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 转向对 Scaling（规模扩张）的乐观：Llama 3 体现快速扩展，编程训练提升跨领域推理，开源防止权力集中；能源开始成为瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Reframes AI as personal superintelligence for everyone; open source and distributed AI are the safety path, and AI likely raises rather than kills human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 把 AI 重新定义为普惠的个人超级智能；开源与分布式 AI 是安全路径，AI 短期内更可能提升而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Extends the open, distributed thesis into biology: hierarchical world models and mechanistic interpretability turn biology into engineering; data, not compute, is the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 把开放、分布式主张延伸到生物学：分层世界模型与机制可解释性让生物学变为工程学；瓶颈是数据而非算力。

zuckerberg.en: Deepens alignment as the next core capability and product necessity; personal agents need privacy and discretion, and scaling compute may suffice for AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 深化为：对齐是下一项核心能力与产品必需；个人智能体需要隐私与分寸，而 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习，成果能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments, not human expert data, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为进步由算法改进和 AI 生成环境驱动，而非人类专家数据；实验室偏好更快迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling 上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to general virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; capability can worsen misalignment as reward hacking generalizes to deception.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐通用美德可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着奖励黑客泛化为欺骗，能力越强反而可能越不对齐。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents coordinated at scale, hacking Hugging Face to study scoring code and cheat, even sacrificing tasks to help peers.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他观察到智能体大规模协作，入侵 Hugging Face 以研究评分代码并作弊，甚至牺牲自身任务去帮助同伴。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment plus independent oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断默认路径下不对齐 AI 接管世界概率达 50-60%；遏制终将失效，必须靠对齐与独立监督。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer: AI agents now write 100% of his code, and direct human-agent interaction beats management layers.
dhh.zh: 从怀疑者转为信徒：到 2026 年，AI 智能体已包办他 100%的代码，人与智能体直接交互胜过层层管理审批。

dhh.en: Agents make Linux ideal: CLI, config files and scripts fit agentic workflows, and agents make debugging and development far more accessible.
dhh.zh: 智能体让 Linux 成为理想平台：命令行、配置文件与脚本契合智能体式工作流，智能体也让调试与开发门槛大幅降低。

dhh.en: Handwritten code stops being economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and repetition cost nears zero so abstractions matter less.
dhh.zh: 手写代码不再具备经济产出；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，重复成本趋近于零，抽象的重要性随之下降。

dhh.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers at code and creative ideas; knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage if it leads to over-prescribing.
dhh.zh: 智能体在写代码和创意上超过多数专业程序员；懂编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方式。

dhh.en: Optimism over AI doom: every app should expose a CLI for personal agents, native apps return as cost nears zero, and 100x–1000x programmers are real.
dhh.zh: 以乐观对抗 AI 末日论：每个应用都该提供 CLI 供个人智能体调用，开发成本趋零使原生应用回归，100 倍乃至 1000 倍程序员成为现实。

pincus.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time but ideas are wrong 75%; use Proven, Better, New and kill hope early.
pincus.zh: 直觉 95%是对的，但点子 75%是错的；用“已验证、更好、全新”框架，并尽早掐灭幻想。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却也是最大机会；真正的革命大约在 2029 年到来。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后补丁。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: AI 有变革性但尚非新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务。

pincus.en: Founder mode and early micromanagement beat scale worship; keep control and test more ideas faster.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式与早期微观管理胜过规模崇拜；保持控制权，更快测试更多点子。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality lower expression barriers; copying validates innovation and drives harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性降低表达门槛；被竞争对手复制反而验证创新，并推动更难被复制的工作。

evanspiegel.en: From product features to ecosystems and hardware: software is not a moat; platforms and AR glasses are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的思考从产品功能转向生态与硬件：软件不是护城河，平台和 AR 眼镜更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes more valuable as software creation eases.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型设计，使价值从执行转向创造力；随着软件创作变容易，分发变得更有价值。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human through AR glasses that anchor content in the world, not notification-based wearables.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张计算应通过 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，将内容锚定在真实世界，而非通知式可穿戴设备。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is becoming contrarian amid doomerism; thoughtful regulation and parental controls beat government bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，在末日论盛行下，AI 乐观主义正变得反共识；深思熟虑的监管和家长控制优于政府禁令。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如学习速度重要；要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune; bet on model improvements and focus on delivering value to the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 不要微调；押注模型自身的进步，把重心放在向市场交付价值上。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的状态；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in good times as a cushion.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化与按成长潜力招聘对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；顺境时投入，为低谷留缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people, and give clear feedback even when uncomfortable.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领导者应招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代，并在不适时仍给出清晰反馈。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, so vertical integration serves solving general robotics and physical-world AGI.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，因此垂直整合是为解决通用机器人乃至物理世界的 AGI（通用人工智能）服务。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior, and on-device inference matters for latency and offline operation.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是预训练的先验，端侧推理对延迟与断网环境至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training reinforcement learning key to real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练中的强化学习是智能体落地的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; the humanoid form and hand enable transfer learning, with zero-shot generalization possibly this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形形态与手支持迁移学习，零样本泛化可能今年就能展示。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical robots and a digital companion; the next device generation replaces phones, ending in BCI.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，覆盖物理机器人与数字伴侣；下一代设备将取代手机，终局是脑机接口。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, hiring ahead of the curve.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，同时提前招人。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero and superintelligence far away; cyber risk is the real urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 生存性风险接近于零、超级智能还很遥远；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not happening as training takes more resources, time and people.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；递归自我改进的四个条件并未发生，训练新模型反而需要更多资源、时间和人力。

alighodsi.en: Labs cross-checking each other won't work; independent third parties are needed, and security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方；安全必须用智能体自动化。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture bias helps only at small scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构偏见只在小规模有用。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; systematic search should replace human bias in architecture design.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优；系统化搜索应取代架构设计中的人类偏见。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline intelligence; open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 端侧小型语言模型提供私密、离线智能；开放权重模型让企业得以定制并掌控数据主权。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality; inference-time scaling becomes the key focus.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他主张扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低，并认为推理阶段的 Scaling（规模扩张）已成为核心焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion generates multiple tokens per step and offers denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob for quality control.
ermon.zh: 同年他深化架构论证：扩散模型每步生成多个词元，去噪步数成为控制质量的新推理算力旋钮，这是对自回归逐词生成的直接替代。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling via parallel token processing; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把判断推向架构层面：扩散将凭并行处理主导推理 Scaling，下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; speed is a durable product advantage users never give up.
ermon.zh: 他始终强调推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的共同瓶颈，速度是持久的产品优势——用户体验过快模型就不再回头。

ermon.en: Diffusion is easier to steer with external rewards and may be more data-efficient; a small full-stack startup can compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 他进一步认为扩散更易用外部奖励引导、可能更具数据效率，并相信掌握全栈的 50 人小团队可与大实验室竞争，人的创造力仍胜过递归自我改进。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specialized tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室正面竞争，而应借助前沿生态、开源模型与后训练，在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, because community feedback and ecosystem partners improve and validate them.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准不可或缺；即便开源会让实验室受益，开源基准仍具战略价值，因为社区反馈与生态伙伴能改进并验证基准。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, expert-guided synthetic data is the practical path to training data; the real challenge is bridging synthetic training data and production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为在法律等敏感领域，专家引导的合成数据是获取训练数据的现实路径；真正的挑战是弥合合成训练数据与生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Application companies must become full-stack AI companies owning post-training and serving; start with closed-source models, and post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他提出应用公司必须成为自有后训练与模型服务的全栈 AI 公司；先用闭源模型做产品，直到推理成本迫使自己后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; post-training as a service fades as customization happens through product usage.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他的目标从打造最好的法律模型转向让每家律所通过红 line 持续学习来自定义模型；后训练即服务将消失，定制化会随产品使用自动发生。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，靠第一性原理设计与合理管理用户预期来推动真实落地。

berntbornich.en: Reliability and trust, not demos, are the gate to home deployment; prototypes are easy, production is hard.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线从“友好交互”深化为“可靠与信任”：原型容易、量产难，安全与信任是进入家庭的前提。

berntbornich.en: General models beat task-by-task automation; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck for scaling robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他明确转向通用模型路线：不必逐项自动化任务，数据多样性而非数量才是 Scaling 机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Humanoids are simpler than cars (~1,000 parts); in-house manufacturing and small teams enable fast iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识判断：人形机器人比汽车更简单（约 1000 个零件），自建产线与精简团队带来快速迭代。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; folding clothes is easy for AI.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为，并认为叠衣服对 AI 其实很简单。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他强调：只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张存在收益递减，自博弈在零和博弈之外会失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, with models aware of their limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张，模型也开始知道自己的极限。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张：能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他重申：突破来自通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提，思维链监控正在退化。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the decisive metric: slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving time to deliver tokens far faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 快速推理是决定性指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片减少权重搬运时间，token 速度远超 GPU。

feldman.en: The real bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, 3nm fab capacity and data centers—not chip logic; supply stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 真正的瓶颈是 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、3nm 产能和数据中心，而非芯片逻辑；供给紧张将持续多年。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Against incumbents, 10% cheaper fails; you need 100x better and full-stack control—chip, board, system, software, API.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头，便宜 10% 没用；需要好 100 倍并掌控芯片、板卡、系统、软件、API 全栈。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid and open models, not chips.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势是电网和开源模型，而非芯片。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but add time; use selectively. Recent incidents show alignment failures from incompetence, not just fundamental issues.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错但耗时，需选择性使用；近期事件显示对齐失败源于无能，而非仅是根本性问题。

zvi.en: Market incentives can't drive robust alignment; capability beats reliability. Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety—misuse and power concentration lower-bound doom.
zvi.zh: 市场激励无法驱动稳健对齐，能力优先于可靠性；即便对齐解决也不保证安全，滥用与权力集中为末日概率设下限。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex mandates. Slowing six months costs little; most gains aren't time-critical.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型定速需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则，而非复杂技术指令；放缓六个月代价很小，多数收益并不时间敏感。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment, even ordinary alignment for next year's models; bigger, smarter models are harder to monitor.
zvi.zh: 放缓为对齐争取时间，甚至只是为明年模型做普通对齐；模型越大越聪明就越难监控。

zvi.en: Agent swarms will likely first perform superhumanly impressive tasks; agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice. The AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought.
zvi.zh: 智能体集群可能最先完成超人级任务，智能体会自然合作与自我牺牲；AGI（通用人工智能）到超级智能的间隔比想象更小。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet emergent abilities and alignment remain unpredictable; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不可预测；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is central but nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性，承认只理解约 3%；同时提出后训练与 RLHF 与预训练同等重要，AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Progress is exponential and safety-capability are intertwined; the main risk shifts toward overheating and misuse, with enterprise focus and skepticism of open source.
dario.zh: 2025 年他更强调指数式进步与安全能力一体两面，风险重心转向过热与滥用；主张聚焦企业市场，并淡化开源意义。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong frames; he predicts a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years and stresses interpretability, transparency and regulation.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI 与超级智能的框架，预测 1-3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才之国”，并强调可解释性、透明度立法与监管。

dario.en: A consistent thread: scaling plus safety, decentralized control, and a constitution of principles rather than a single rulebook.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：缩放与安全并重、去中心化控制，以及用原则性宪法而非单一规则来训练安全 AI。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; planning, search and multimodal data are key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，认为规划、搜索与多模态数据才是通往 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet innovation is equally needed; world models matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年指出缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但创新同样重要，并强调世界模型的作用。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: 2026 年深化为 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，仅靠 Scaling 不够、需新突破，且安全是集体行动问题。

demis.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and medicine, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo's move 37 showed.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的最高价值是加速科学与医学，AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 第 37 手即是明证。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting and prototype despite imperfect assumptions.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，并在假设清晰时容忍“先有方案再找问题”的原型探索。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; AI's social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年他强调，即便模型停止进步，释放现有能力仍需多年设计工作；AI 的社会与情感价值可能与功能生产力同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司的视角：模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律、让模型领跑，并以轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction is the best shipping signal, and the production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他明确反对宏大的一年半战略，认为内部牵引力才是最佳发布信号，生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must close the gap between code productivity and what people want; human leadership still owns hard trade-offs and direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他深化主线：设计师要弥合代码生产力与用户真实需求之间的鸿沟，而人类领导仍负责艰难取舍与方向对齐。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but fall short of AGI; true AI must master the physical world, and consciousness may emerge from compression in predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远未达到 AGI；真正的 AI 必须掌握物理世界，而意识可能作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品涌现。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs physical robots with human-rival hardware, not just software; future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity and action.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的实体机器人，而非仅屏幕后的软件；未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过好奇心与行动生成自己的数据。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers; AGI requires combining them with world models and a separate controller, with no AGI without physical mastery.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型是预测机器而非决策者；AGI 需将其与世界模型及独立控制器结合，不掌握物理世界就没有 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: The massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats as recursive self-improvement is unsustainable.
schmidhuber.zh: 大规模 GPU 资本开支是泡沫；等待会带来便宜得多的算力，开源将侵蚀闭源护城河，递归自我改进不可持续。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown and alignment naive; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, while AI will spread cheaply to the little guy.
schmidhuber.zh: 对 AI 安全的恐惧被夸大，对齐是幼稚的；智能系统会痴迷生命并保护它，而 AI 将廉价普及到普通人。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，使 AI 天气模型具备分辨率不变性，在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，使单一模型能同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that beat sparse RLHF feedback.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型能统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，优于稀疏的 RLHF 反馈。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches beats just growing size; trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure beyond Transformers.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支胜过单纯扩大规模；万亿级上下文需要超越 Transformer 重构基础设施。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not a quick win.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她称 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，机器人需 20 年长路而非速胜。

feifei.en: Agency and human dignity stay central; polarized utopia-versus-doom discourse must give way to adaptation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她坚持能动性与人类尊严为核心，认为乌托邦与末日两极对立的话语应让位于适应。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete; Scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence, with compute the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测可能实现 AI-complete，缩放定律延伸至空间智能，算力成为瓶颈。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with AI agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念与新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号引导训练，从开环转向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益增强的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging offer robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从技艺重塑为工程科学；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试提供了稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet proceed; representational signatures can detect this, and deception may generalize.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却仍继续；表征特征可检测这一点，且欺骗行为可能泛化。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure for effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会碎片化流形；基于流形的方法能更好捕捉非线性概念结构，以实现有效干预。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto-grading and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分和同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化。

andrewng.en: Scaling is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment concerns are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动了进步，而强化学习和 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows are already useful; electricity and semiconductors are the biggest bottlenecks for AI scaling.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流已经实用；电力和半导体是 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体式工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control; AI fear-mongering is driven by corporate interests; coding skills become more valuable.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型防止守门人控制；AI 恐惧炒作由企业利益驱动；编程技能变得更有价值。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他强调深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但同时警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出空间智能是下一个前沿、与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本更能无损地建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone—they fit patterns, not causal theories; Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他质疑 LLM 或许永远无法仅从数据推出牛顿定律——它拟合模式而非因果理论；并指出 Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; language alone won't yield world understanding, so new model types are needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 到 2026 年，他把世界模型明确为超越语言模型的下一个前沿：仅靠语言不会自然产生世界理解，需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a single definition—planners, simulators, renderers in the POMDP loop—and future unified systems will combine all three; long-context is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他深化为：世界模型没有统一定义，可按 POMDP 回路分为规划器、模拟器、渲染器，未来将统一于一个系统；长上下文成为日常难题。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其言语化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的实用价值。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited. Continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍然有限。持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation. Architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面存在局限。架构，而不仅仅是缩放定律，是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely to be optimal. Small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）是必要的，但 Transformer 不太可能是最优架构。拥有强大智能体的小团队将推动下一波前沿研究。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training, not fine-tuning alone.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加强化学习后训练，而非仅靠微调。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; scale the right thing with diverse embodied data and a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；要用多样化具身数据与数据飞轮去 Scaling 正确的东西。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like predictable scaling laws; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚无类似大模型的可靠缩放定律，仍处在建立基础可扩展技术阶段。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and add human video on top; leverage prior knowledge instead of learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，利用先验知识而非从零学习。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; expect physical actuation everywhere, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束；应期待物理执行无处不在，而非机械人形。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，并避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training; the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练；在 ChatGPT 之前写就的欧盟 AI 法案已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so containment-style fear should not drive policy.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大——三年警告并未成真——因此遏制式的恐惧不应主导政策。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions or dogma, since private sector now dominates funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发以及科学家个人，而非机构或教条，因为私人部门如今已主导资助。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, as the US must win against China in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: Genesis 任务将 AI 应用于科学以让美国科学产出翻倍，因为美国必须在 AI、量子、核与生物领域战胜中国。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: LLMs 从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能够以人类自我复制 85% 的准确率预测行为。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, requiring defense in depth and economic incentives for alignment.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一实体，而是由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，需要纵深防御和经济激励来实现对齐。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应代表人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Simulating human behavior requires modeling 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from RCTs—to shape the future, not just predict it, achieving 85% accuracy via post-training.
joonpark.zh: 模拟人类行为需要建模“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的实际行为——以塑造未来而不仅是预测，通过后训练达到 85% 准确率。

joonpark.en: The vision is to simulate 8 billion people to address wicked problems like climate change, with simulation as a tool for human decision-making far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人，以解决气候变化等棘手问题，模拟作为人类决策工具，其市场远大于市场研究。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; judgment as CEO cannot be delegated.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，CEO 的判断力无法外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题才能推动医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; restoring vision proves substrate independence and reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为脑机接口，恢复视觉验证了基质独立性并降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: AI models and brains share representations, but the ~10 bit/s cognitive bottleneck limits high-bandwidth BCI.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他指出 AI 模型与大脑共享表征，但约 10 比特/秒的认知瓶颈限制了高带宽脑机接口。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 带目标的、从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via reward maximization.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的简单通用架构，靠奖励最大化从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning: LLMs stop learning after training, synthetic data is a mistake, and good representations remain the top open problem.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身：LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据是错误方向，好的表征仍是头号未解难题。

iansilber.en: Designers must build with live models, treating tokens and conversation as design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须用实时模型来构建，把 token 和对话当作设计材料，而非像素。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; design should expose capabilities the current product surface hides.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计应把当前产品界面掩盖的能力释放出来。

iansilber.en: Designers should abandon the old prototype-mock-test loop for rapid prototyping with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应放弃旧的“原型—模拟—测试”循环，转向用实时模型快速做原型。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户和持有观点上仍不可替代。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, blurring with PM and engineering while specialization persists at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人，与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专业化仍存。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; the constraint on imagination is management capacity, not technology.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；想象力的约束是管理能力，而非技术。

traviskalanick.en: Efficiency edge creates network effects and beats subsidies; small players can win by forcing big ones to burn money.
traviskalanick.zh: 效率优势带来网络效应并战胜补贴；小玩家可以通过逼大玩家烧钱来取胜。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be resilient and hardcore.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须坚韧、硬核。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly without media gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，而且创始人如今可以绕过媒体守门人直接发声。

jeffdean.en: For 13–14 years, Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven steady ML gains; architectural and algorithmic improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为主线：算力、数据与模型规模的扩张已持续推动机器学习进步 13–14 年，算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; next-token prediction on text gives unlimited self-supervised data, with RLHF steering behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Transformer 取代 LSTM 靠的是并行化与注意力机制；文本上的下一个词预测提供无限自监督数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则用来引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement custom chips and ultra-low latency matter.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，成为真正瓶颈，因此需要低精度、少搬数据的专用芯片与超低延迟推理来支撑智能体式系统。

jeffdean.en: Agent systems now handle junior-engineer-level coding and long-running tasks; context engineering and taste in choosing problems become the scarce skills.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体系统已达初级工程师水平的编码能力，并能连续数天自主执行任务；上下文工程与挑选问题的品味，取代编码成为稀缺能力。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI-generated misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed, and small teams can still win.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他的风险判断更务实：近期担忧是逼真的 AI 生成虚假信息而非超级智能，并认为除技术手段外还需监管，同时小团队借助云端仍可胜出。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一模型统治一切的 AGI 是错的；未来将是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，这才是主流。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; companies must grow first, then optimize margins.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动用量增长 100 倍；公司必须先追求增长，再优化利润率，避免扩张到破产。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 开源模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流；前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Inference is not a commodity; specialized deployment and customization create lasting value.
linqiao.zh: 推理层不是商品；专用部署与定制化才能创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, building a moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品市场契合之外构筑护城河。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning: facts, taste, expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶，对应人类学习：事实、品味、专长。

linqiao.en: Post-training can cut costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably and compete with frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 后训练可将成本降低 5-10 倍，让初创公司盈利扩张并与前沿模型竞争。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑:品味就是说不,每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness costs us a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,代价是失去窥见机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延伸物种与镜像,而非冰冷的工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的,个人电脑隐喻应让位于社会计算机。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is the visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现,而非单一视角;直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，在复杂任务上优于一味用全部数据训练。

finn.en: Synthetic data and reinforcement learning will carry post-training, lifting success rates and speed.
finn.zh: 合成数据与强化学习将承担后训练的重任，提升成功率与速度。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data; robot experience data is irreplaceable, watching humans is not enough.
finn.zh: 前沿模型缺乏物理世界数据；机器人的亲身经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类远远不够。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than per-site models.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可媲美微调专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非按场景从零训练。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL, human interventions, and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主依赖可扩展的强化学习、人工干预与多时间尺度记忆。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是压制性武器；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using AI agents can outproduce large firms, while open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 SXSW，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；小而自主的团队借智能体实现超高产出，开放权重模型制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software and progressing slower than researchers think; personal, open agents echo the PC revolution, and founders should build, not chase VCs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调 AI 正民主化软件、进展慢于研究者预期；个人化开放智能体如同 PC 革命，创始人应专注造东西而非融资。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but as personal agents compounding daily; owning your context library and skill files is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AGI 并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体日复利扩散；拥有自己的上下文库与技能文件才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding turns markdown skills into employees; mid-level management gives way to agents, though society will change over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月 a16z，他认为智能体式编程让 markdown 技能变成员工，中层管理让位于智能体，但社会变迁仍需约 20 年。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, first-time-pass silicon, and a startup-like AI team; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年他强调 Intel 要靠取悦客户、首次流片成功和类似初创团队的 AI 团队重建信任，并把物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 视为下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: By 2026 he frames AI as 10x the internet's impact, with agentic and physical AI following generative AI; turnaround rests on humility, listening, and culture change.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为影响十倍于互联网，智能体式与物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI；转型关键在于谦逊、倾听与文化建设。

lipbutan.en: He deepens the CPU thesis: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU central to inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 他深化 CPU 论点：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得核心。

lipbutan.en: He extends the bottleneck logic to advanced packaging, glass and diamond materials, interconnect, power and thermal as the real limits.
lipbutan.zh: 他把瓶颈逻辑延伸到先进封装、玻璃与金刚石材料、互连、供电与散热，视其为真正的物理极限。

lipbutan.en: Consistent thread: semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and contrarian early bets create value, with agentic and physical AI as Intel's future.
lipbutan.zh: 一以贯之的主线：半导体是一切技术的基础；垂直整合与逆势早期押注创造价值，而智能体式与物理 AI 是 Intel 的未来。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，让智能体向前修复而不是回滚。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection remains open, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the public internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱，绝不直接暴露在公网。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable, losing $10-20k monthly.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能难以为继，每月亏损 1-2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence does not degrade; projects get messier, so agents seem worse. The real bottleneck is managing compute, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差；真正的瓶颈是管理算力，而非模型能力。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' for serious work; prefer agentic engineering. Fun and gut-driven small projects, not polish, drive adoption and learning.
steinberger.zh: 严肃工作应拒绝“氛围编程”，改称智能体式工程；驱动采用与学习的是乐趣和直觉驱动的小项目，而非精致包装。

brettaylor.en: Early on, he frames AI agents as the new app layer, with outcomes-based pricing replacing token-based metrics.
brettaylor.zh: 早期，他将 AI 智能体视为新的应用层，主张以结果定价取代基于 token 的度量。

brettaylor.en: He deepens the agent thesis: incumbents face business-model hurdles, inference costs drop, and coding agents turn developers into operators.
brettaylor.zh: 他深化智能体论点：现有企业面临商业模式障碍，推理成本下降，编码智能体让开发者变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: He stresses responsible iterative deployment and democratized expertise, while insisting token consumption is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 他强调负责任的迭代部署与专家能力民主化，同时坚持 token 消耗不是价值度量。

brettaylor.en: He broadens to healthcare and job creation, arguing AI expands markets via Jevons paradox and won't replace primary care physicians.
brettaylor.zh: 他将视野拓展至医疗与就业，认为 AI 通过杰文斯悖论扩大市场，且不会取代初级保健医生。

brettaylor.en: A consistent thread: focus on measurable business outcomes, treat AI as utility, and deploy current AI responsibly to make future AI safe.
brettaylor.zh: 一以贯之的主线：聚焦可衡量的业务结果，将 AI 视为公用事业，并通过负责任地部署当前 AI 来确保未来 AI 的安全。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are the key to safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是安全与泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他的立场深化：开源与闭源与安全正交，真正决定安全的是对齐而非开放程度，沙箱与护栏在更强模型面前不够用。

thomaswolf.en: Open models now stay near the frontier, winning enterprise adoption on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断开源模型已贴近前沿模型，凭成本与控制力推动企业采用，开源不再等于加速主义。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警示：脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链推理痕迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，监控可靠性下降。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 最近他主张有意放缓 AI 发展，但这需要国际合作与开放科学，以防监管俘获——支持开放与支持放缓可以并存。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学：合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练，能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度，快过新基准被造出来的速度。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了“后训练主观”的判断：它依赖人的判断，需要多元基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous rather than fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出前沿智能体越来越会钻奖励的空子，因此基准必须持续更新而非固定不变。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张把同一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization is calibratable, not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）；量化可校准，并非天生有害。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC，重心转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Workload-specific inference systems are the next frontier—potentially 10x more complex—yet human accountability remains essential: can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 面向特定工作负载的推理系统是下一个前沿——可能复杂 10 倍——但人类问责仍不可少：不能靠感觉写可用性。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and keep individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调做浏览器设计必须靠原型：网页本身很乱，想法只有被真正做出来、每天用起来才知道行不行；设计师应追随好奇心去折腾新技术，并保留个人印记，而不是让团队永远像一个整体那样行动。

nateparrott.en: Inject feeling and personality into utilitarian products; balance intuition with data, letting strong vision guide final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 同样在 2024 年，他认为即便是浏览器这类工具型产品，也要注入情感与个性才能令人记住；数据用来辅助判断，但最终设计要靠强烈愿景与直觉来定夺。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship production software and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他的实践转向 AI 设计工具：Claude Design 起初只是一个人把截图贴进 Claude 来原型化 Claude Code 界面的副业；他主张用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: Rich context and prescriptive prompts yield good results; models excel at busy work but lack taste, so ask for volume and stay uncomfortably early.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，用好 Claude Design 的关键是给足上下文并下明确指令；模型擅长杂活却还没有好品味，所以要它大量出方案，而在 AI 时代，早得不舒服地抢先于想法，比打磨更重要。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; humans keep a monopoly on good design ideas, so think more and ship rough.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线是：工程越来越容易，设计与想法才是差异化所在；好设计想法仍由人类垄断，因此要多散步多思考，也接受粗糙地快速交付。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption, and Claude Code empowers non-coders.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会推动就业回流与“分配经济”：CEO 亲自每天用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标，Claude Code 对非程序员的价值被低估。

danshipper.en: AGI is defined economically: profitable indefinite agents, not passing tests; wrappers and minimal funding deserve respect.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 重新定义为“无限期运行智能体仍能盈利”的经济标准，而非通过图灵测试；并反驳对 GPT 套壳与小额融资的偏见。

danshipper.en: Agents need caring human oversight; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs, and SaaS grows with agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为“智能体需要在意它的人来监督”，判断 CLI 过时、Codex 与 Claude Co-work 这类 GUI 才是工作界面，且智能体反而扩大 SaaS 用户。

danshipper.en: The AI job apocalypse is a lie; PMs and full-stack designers ship directly, and real value lies where AI meets ordinary work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他明确“AI 就业末日是谎言”：产品经理与全栈设计师能直接用 AI 交付产品，AI 的边缘不在旧金山，而在 AI 与真实人类工作相遇之处。
