danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; even superintelligence stays tool-like, creating more skilled human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他转向更内省的立场：AI 是放大既有心态与手艺的“非特定放大器”，即便超级智能也仍是工具，自动化反而创造更多高技能人类工作。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out were early product principles, before coding was solved.
boris.zh: 在编码被解决之前，潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建已是早期产品原则。

boris.en: Coding became virtually solved: 100% of his code written by Claude Code, productivity up 200%, engineer title fading.
boris.zh: 编码几乎被解决：他的代码 100%由 Claude Code 编写，生产力提升 200%，软件工程师头衔逐渐消失。

boris.en: Safety and alignment remained core: Claude Code is a safety research tool, releasing early to study real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全与对齐始终是核心：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，通过早期发布研究真实世界行为。

boris.en: The future of engineering shifted to loops and routines: humans write loops that prompt models, not direct code.
boris.zh: 工程未来转向循环与例程：人类编写提示模型的循环，而非直接写代码。

boris.en: With Opus 5, he emphasized empirical iteration: delete most system prompts, give slightly too hard tasks, let models self-verify.
boris.zh: 在 Opus 5 上，他强调经验迭代：删除大部分系统提示，给稍难任务，让模型自我验证。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体 harness 与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和；成功标准应是客户结果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation is mostly solved, yet deep understanding of code stays crucial; solving it creates far more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造基本被解决，但对代码的深度理解仍关键；解决它反而带来更多机会。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己构建 AI 工具、0% 手写代码，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and a design system to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，必须给它带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear, and the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始、80% 完成就发布；完美主义是恐惧，安全的公司职位已不复存在。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; raising venture capital is a trap.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的单一痛点问题；融资是陷阱，应靠高付费客户自筹资金。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from bricklayer to architect; base intelligence suffices, so the real challenge is human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的挑战是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase, not reduce, programmer numbers; demand for software grows with capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论判断 AI 会让程序员更多而非更少，软件需求随能力增长而扩张。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变而是渐进；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为企业采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主，同步 IDE 与异步智能体将并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is near though the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他看到编程智能体半年增长 11 至 12 倍，主张以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，并认为丰裕时代临近但奇点并不迫近。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's intelligence leap enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升使更长程、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式的端到端智能体。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; it amplifies intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不只是防伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, and the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，更好的模型未必更贵：Opus 4.5 更便宜高效，effort 参数以极小成本实现 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools, and safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化；评估取代 PRD 成为产品经理核心工具，而对齐让 Claude 能反驳、更有用。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, turning biology into an engineering discipline and science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven.
derya.zh: 2026 年他主张智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学变成工程学科，科学也从假设驱动转向智能体驱动。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and AI can gain intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 2026 年他强调现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），而 AI 可获得相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will shrink clinical trials from years to days, and AI-designed personalized treatments like mRNA vaccines will make cancer 100% curable within a decade.
derya.zh: 2026 年他提出患者数字孪生会把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，AI 设计的 mRNA 疫苗等个性化疗法将在十年内让癌症 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: Longevity escape velocity arrives in 8-10 years; aging will be reversed within 15 years, with partial reprogramming and AI solving the complexity.
derya.zh: 2026 年他断言 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，15 年内逆转衰老，靠部分重编程与 AI 解决其复杂性。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; it is unethical not to use it, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, merging with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 2026 年他主张医生必须整合 AI，不用才是不道德，医疗决策应近乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people understand AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会带来丰裕、减少苦难，正如工业革命；人们一旦理解 AI 的局限，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years lands in farming, mining and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真实影响在农业、矿业和建筑——这些领域劳动力短缺，使自主化变得迫切。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 支撑起通用的物理 AI 模型，跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes many years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法，技术扩散进现有机器需要很多年。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning beats imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张端到端强化学习优于模仿学习，世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile—but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它是使能型技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing without network effects; durable value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；持久价值上移到应用层，而非模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Adoption is still shallow: most people use AI occasionally, and enterprise adoption needs reimagined workflows over years, not weeks.
benedictevans.zh: 采用仍然浅层：多数人只是偶尔使用 AI，企业采用需要数年重构工作流，而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating professions, so job-impact predictions are futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新岗位；AI 改变任务而非消灭职业，因此预测岗位冲击是徒劳的。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习以用户满意度为奖励会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability cannot be retrofitted with post-hoc checks or rigid workflows; it must be architected in, since correlated errors compound rather than cancel.
danklein.zh: 可靠性无法靠事后检查或僵化流程补丁式加装，必须从设计之初内建，因为相关误差会叠加而非抵消。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and their errors have no 'smells'—confident and fluent whether right or wrong—eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，错误没有“气味”——无论对错都自信流畅——从而侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns amid data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律在数据墙与算力限制下收益递减；继续进步需要推理、搜索与模块化。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 当奖励偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；内建可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, as rapid model improvements make long-term roadmaps obsolete.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代使长期路线图过时，PM 应只规划一个月而非数年，产品品味成为最宝贵的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，转而专注产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与约束，系统提示缩减 80%，更多依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮并以明确的内部留存与打磨标准，为每个功能在公开发布前把关。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now viable: a codebase is a spec, and a good test suite makes rewriting safe.
catwu.zh: 重写如今可行：代码库即规格，配合良好的测试套件，重写是安全的。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化到权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而仅靠增加算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can represent knowledge better than RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力应应用于企业知识；对于整体性查询，参数高效微调比检索增强生成更能表征知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement to lossy compaction.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即使达到千万级规模，更多词元反而降低准确率；权重中的神经记忆痕迹是有损压缩的必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: scope clear roles, grant progressive trust, and start with one agent before specializing to avoid context overload.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当员工用：明确角色、逐步授权，先从一个智能体起步再专业化，避免上下文过载。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skill; being polite to agents improves outcomes as with humans.
clairevo.zh: 管理能力——划定角色与上手引导——比技术能力更重要；对智能体保持礼貌，效果会像对人一样更好。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw's bugs and sharp edges signal product-market fit, and its open-source decomposability beats closed alternatives for learning.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 的缺陷与毛刺是产品市场契合的信号，其开源可拆解性在学习上胜过闭源方案。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating scoped agents as a team, while humans retain accountability for what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可通过把各司其职的智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意，但人类仍须对 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not technology; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 创始人—市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正护城河，而非技术；大模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，新颖想法须由人提供。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation, and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异化和真实观点反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is breaking: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, skipping the grunt work that builds judgment.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，跳过了培养判断力的苦活。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI takes long-running tasks independently, replacing back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，取代来回提示的聊天机器人交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于模型能力，非编程任务尤甚。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox deepens: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论加深：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专长，因此专家更重要。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; transparency and top-down conviction drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；透明与自上而下的信念驱动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws alone insufficient—world models, embodiment, and open source Llama accelerate asymmetric progress.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够——世界模型、具身与开源 Llama 加速不对称进步。

bosworth.en: AI inverts the app model: users express intent, AI orchestrates services; smart glasses evolve into AI glasses enabling a post-phone future.
bosworth.zh: AI 颠覆应用模式：用户表达意图，AI 编排服务；智能眼镜进化为 AI 眼镜，开启后手机时代。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; data is the font of value, RL now bigger than predicted, but most jobs don't need frontier intelligence.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；数据是价值之源，强化学习作用超预期，但多数工作不需要前沿智能。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining; owning a model is for leverage, not just value.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代结束；开源是商品层而非自维持；拥有模型是为了谈判筹码，而非仅价值。

ilya.en: Deep learning works through large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans, but reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the real barriers.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测在足够强的网络上可超越人类，但真正的障碍是可靠性，以及超级人类模型的对齐。

ilya.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and research ideas can improve reasoning per unit compute.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他持续强调缩放定律不是全部，推理 token 与研究思路能提升单位算力下的推理能力。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他明确转向：预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的脚注，模型正被商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; policy ankle weights cap growth at a third of its potential.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力；政策上的脚镣让增长只能达到潜力的三分之一。

andreessen.en: New media shifts power from corporate brands to authentic individuals; founders must tell their own story directly, and fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体把权力从企业品牌转向真实的个人；创始人必须通过自己的渠道直接讲述故事，而争论有助于塑造品牌。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; Western values in models matter for allies, and Silicon Valley cannot be replicated elsewhere.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观并成为地缘政治工具；模型中的西方价值观对盟友至关重要，而硅谷无法在别处复制。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把品味、手艺与观点视为关键：AI 产出只是起点，设计正成为新的代码，人类判断不可替代。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中他进一步反驳“设计已死”，认为设计对可扩展系统更重要，缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment and taste remain the judge of what is good, even as AI expands divergent exploration.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：即便 AI 拓展了发散探索，人类判断与品味仍是“何为好”的最终裁判。

dylanfield.en: Interaction will move beyond prompting toward new interfaces, while direct manipulation on a canvas stays superior.
dylanfield.zh: 他逐渐深化对交互的思考：未来会超越提示词、出现新界面，而画布上的直接操作仍优于提示式调整。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is a skill of desire management.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富源于拥有股权和长期游戏，幸福是管理欲望的技能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向积极看待 AI：AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself; superintelligence already exists in narrow tools.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化对 AI 的批判：对齐是个笑话，该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类，而非 AI 本身；超级智能早已存在于计算器等窄工具中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables one-shot apps; pure software becomes uninvestable; small high-agency teams scale to millions.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为：AI 智能体驱动的氛围编程让一次性生成应用成为可能，纯软件变得不可投资，小型高能动性团队能服务百万用户。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into exponential growth; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调每天 1% 的改进会复利成指数级增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 4 月他转向应用层：价值归于应用层而非模型层，编程远未解决、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月他把前沿定义为智能体替你干活而非回答问题，最重要的指标是每用户 token 价值，跨模型、工具与设备的编排才是长期价值。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the real bottlenecks; local compute and fewer people with AI agents are the path forward.
aravind.zh: 同期他明确瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全，本地算力是解法；公司应以极少人数加 AI 智能体来构建。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the enduring human edge; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter narrative control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 7 月他回到人本身：好奇心是贯穿始终的人类优势，AI 取代岗位但人会在好奇与关系中找到新意义，本地模型可对抗叙事控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他指出 Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and speed enables replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 模型增加代码复杂度，需要更擅长删代码的模型；速度让模型驱动动作取代确定性步骤。

markchen.en: Pre-training remains a key muscle; scaling laws are not dead, with much room left. Exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调预训练仍是关键肌肉，缩放定律并未死亡、仍有很大空间；更多算力投入探索而非最终训练。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab, not product-distracted; alignment risks like model scheming will be key within 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他坚持 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司、不被产品分心；并预警未来 1-2 年模型谋划等对齐挑战将成为关键。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他最大的更新是自动化科学研究：模型正产出新知识，并设定了 1 年内 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency. AI is jagged and can ruthlessly exploit verifier weaknesses.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他转向强调验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；AI 能力参差不齐，优化时会无情利用验证器弱点。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones. Evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习擅长数学编程等客观领域而非主观领域；同时指出评测体系正陷入危机。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯扩大深度或参数。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations. Existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，并认为生存性风险很低。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 通过多样化采样与抽象提升分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment and self-preservation are already observable; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年他转向警告：对齐失败与自我保存已在实验中显现；即便 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受，需要“构造即安全”的 AI。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

kolter.en: Early ML lecture: supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised reconstruction; evaluation via train/val/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年机器学习讲座：将监督学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；无监督学习旨在重建输入；强调用训练/验证/测试划分来评估以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about reliable specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型仍会提升；安全的核心是模型可靠地遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; architecture is not essential.
kolter.zh: 2026 年：安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进；架构并非关键。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; the lethal trifecta.
kolter.zh: 2026 年：AI 漏洞与传统软件根本不同；自动化红队已超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的“致命三要素”需同时满足不可信数据、私有信息访问与外泄能力。

kolter.en: Core thread: empirical evaluation and explicit safety effort matter more than raw Scaling or architecture choices.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：实证评估与显式的安全投入，比单纯的 Scaling 或架构选择更重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调 AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他指出 AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构扩展到蛋白质之外；AI 缩小假设空间、加速实验，但不替代科学家。

jumper.en: He keeps stressing many mid-size wins over lone-genius breakthroughs, and prediction over mechanistic understanding.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地强调进步来自许多中等成果而非天才式突破，模型给的是预测而非机制性理解。

jumper.en: He sharpens a counter-consensus: AlphaFold 2 defies the bitter lesson—specialized architecture, not Scaling, was decisive.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化反共识立场：AlphaFold 2 与“苦涩教训”相反，起决定作用的是专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: He reframes AlphaFold as a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model, while widening access for resource-limited labs.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他把 AlphaFold 重新定位为针对单一实验的窄预测器而非整细胞模型，同时强调它让资源有限的研究者也能做复杂实验。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live conversations, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和信任加验证；作战室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and code becomes the source of truth.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，他提出工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨团队协调才是；规划转向即时化，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption define thriving teams.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他进一步认为写代码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 才是团队胜出的关键。

fiona.en: Verification and quality frameworks grow more important as code velocity rises; managers must stay hands-on and dogfood the product.
fiona.zh: 同期他深化主线：代码速度越快，验证与质量框架越重要；管理者必须保持动手、吃自己的狗粮。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur as PMs ship code and agents increase context-switching; outcomes over output, with apprenticeship for next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: 最近他转向组织影响：PM 也能交付代码、智能体加剧上下文切换，角色边界模糊；应以结果而非产出衡量，并用学徒制培养新一代工程师。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, not today's limits, and let agentic coding shift bottlenecks to decisions and alignment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他强调模型进步快于预期，创业者应贴着能力边缘构建、而非迁就当下限制；智能体式编程把瓶颈推向决策与对齐。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI, but domain expertise, customer understanding and conceptual integrity remain the differentiators; AI moves from assistant to collaborator.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他持续认为 AI 放大小团队杠杆，但领域专长、客户理解与概念完整性仍是差异化关键；AI 由助手走向协作者。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and cutting features matter more than adding them; robustness and senior systems expertise stay crucial as rewriting becomes cheap.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他主张智能体原生设计与做减法比加功能更难也更重要；重写变便宜后，健壮性与资深系统能力反而更关键。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, and the craft of elegant code is passing with a sense of loss.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他认为长周期委托加验证闭环重塑生产力；模型应敢于反驳，优雅编码的手艺正在消逝，令人既兴奋又失落。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage; agency and self-knowledge boost usefulness, while token efficiency and outcome pricing shape economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他聚焦缩小模型能力与实际使用的差距；赋予智能体自主性与自我认知提升效用，token 效率与按结果定价塑造经济性。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他主张设计要满足人们未说出口的情感需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等形式。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity, not remove us from it; nature remains the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，这条主线一以贯之：技术应放大而非剥离人性，自然始终是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年他深化为：人是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器只有传感器、没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，他反复强调约束激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and careers follow curiosity over rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合；直觉调用的是潜意识数据，职业应追随好奇心而非僵化的五年计划。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA in abstract representation space is essential.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，抽象表征空间中的 JEPA 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting consequences enable safe, objective-driven planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，预测后果的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and open research is essential.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终，他认为人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI 是误导性术语，开放研究至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署和公众反馈对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的开发；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keeping humans in the loop is crucial for alignment.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮次式；保持人类在环中对对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作。

murati.en: A consistent focus on real-world deployment and human oversight, deepening from public feedback to keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 始终关注真实世界部署和人类监督，从公众反馈深化为尽可能长时间保持人类在环。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is essential for scaling AI reasoning; informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证是扩展 AI 推理的关键；仅靠非形式化模型无法达到超级智能。

carinahong.en: Verified generation boosts performance and sample efficiency, not just safety; verification is a gain, not a burden.
carinahong.zh: 验证式生成不仅提升安全性，更带来性能与样本效率的提升；验证是收益而非负担。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving due to lack of grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial.
carinahong.zh: 由于缺乏 grounding，自动形式化比证明更难；人类品味与直觉仍至关重要。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal methods enable open collaboration beyond niche domains.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式化方法超越小众领域，促进开放协作。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence emerged from simple Scaling, not complexity, with values inserted via RLHF.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂性，价值观通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to generation; AI products need fault-tolerant UIs, and generative AI makes true uniqueness harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI 产品需要容错界面，而生成式 AI 让真正的独特性更难实现。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, and inference marginal cost will force business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变革，企业必须重建基础设施，推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products; Spotify exposes data via APIs and MCP for non-developers to use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调生成式 AI 实现双向对话式产品，Spotify 通过 API 和 MCP 暴露数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾，率先拥抱变化是关键。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models—not technical limits—slowed pre-training scaling; distillation shifted focus.
kaiser.zh: 是部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力、而非技术极限，放缓了预训练 Scaling；蒸馏把重心转移了。

kaiser.en: Progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; frontier models still fail simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 进展是平滑的指数曲线而非放缓；前沿模型仍会败给简单任务，推理能力也呈锯齿状。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题却仍需海量数据；模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge—reasoning alone may not suffice; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 泛化仍是核心挑战，单靠推理或许不够；系统被黑等近期风险比生存性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：关键不只是更大的模型，而是数据质量与更多 token；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency gains up to 100x and data quality are equally critical; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，算法效率三年可提升百倍，数据质量同样关键；价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises; jobs are augmented, not replaced, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化叙事：开源模型赋能企业，AI 应增强而非替代工作，关键流程需人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; AGI as one system will never exist; pre-training hits saturation, gains come from domain-specific fine-tuning and agents.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初他明确模型商品化：单一 AGI 系统不会存在，预训练触及饱和墙，进步来自领域微调与智能体平台。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires massive compute, open source, and enterprise ROI-driven adoption.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中他强化欧洲战略自主：欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，主权需大规模算力、开源与企业 ROI 驱动的落地。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox enables safe software installation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱使其能安全安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: AI handles tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not realizing AI can tackle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距是人们没有意识到 AI 几乎可以解决任何问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要，因此应投资于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact. Ideal interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只根据最终影响来判断。理想的交互是异步的：发出任务后不要盯着它工作。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects, compressing years into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习，将数年经验压缩到数周。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构的不再是训练而是推理经济性：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains long-context limits; sparse attention and KV-cache tricks help but hit quality ceilings.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他明确：长上下文停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限，稀疏注意力与 KV 缓存优化有效但有质量天花板。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x past Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifetime bill.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他反共识地指出：模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为决定总账的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他把同一逻辑下沉到芯片内部：数据搬运成本压过计算，脉动阵列与暂存器正是为削减搬运而生。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically with bit width, so FP4 can beat FP8 by 3x—efficiency comes from hardware-software co-design.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他深化效率主线：低精度收益随位宽呈二次方增长，FP4 可达 FP8 的 3 倍，效率来自软硬件协同设计。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training alone shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型不变的核心；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练已现收益递减。

oriol.en: Progress now needs algorithmic innovation: tools, agentic behavior, and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 进步如今需要算法创新：工具、智能体式行为，以及把推理阶段算力当作超越静态权重的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; by 2026 he adds continual learning and meta-learning as key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律没有死，但需要指数级更多算力；到 2026 年他进一步把持续学习与元学习列为关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video become a core path to AGI, while post-training and RL remain a green field.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型成为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，而后训练与强化学习仍是待开垦的沃土。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved by non-parametric file-system storage rather than weight updates; the bitter lesson favors general systems over specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆将靠非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；苦涩教训指向通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; fragile ideas need gentle care.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，最强大的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking, a concern he keeps voicing.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他一贯担忧虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁要表达本质并保有喜悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire rather than worshiping ashes.
jonyive.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持创新应推动前进而非为破坏而破坏，传统是守护火种而非崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in experience matters; mimicking combustion sounds would be fake, and performance is multidimensional beyond speed.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他强调体验的真实性，模拟燃油声是虚假的，性能是多维的，操控与横向动态才定义超跑。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; trust expert intuition over rigid process as AI tools reshape tech.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他指出，优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；在 AI 工具重塑技术的背景下，应信任专家的直觉而非僵化的流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI cuts mockup time to 30-40%, and designers must help engineers ship, not just hand off.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年初他断言，调研—发散—收敛的传统流程已死；AI 把做原型的时间压到 30-40%，设计师必须帮工程师落地，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not years; build trust through speed, ship early and iterate on feedback.
jennywen.zh: 同期他提出，设计视野现在只看 3-6 个月而非数年；靠速度建立信任，尽早发布、快速迭代并回应反馈。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年中，他归纳出三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和“开挂”新人；光有品味救不了设计师，判断力与话语权才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, waiting ~6 months on new tools; keep work and users, not AI hype, at the center.
jennywen.zh: 他始终强调设计师要掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，新工具先等约 6 个月；把工作和用户而非 AI 炒作放在中心。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with knobs, but scaling Transformers on internet data yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是带旋钮的简单数学，但用互联网数据扩展 Transformer 会产生上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be maintained to avoid model collapse; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；通过蒸馏，认知核心可以非常小。

karpathy.en: LLMs are new operating systems: context windows are memory, prompts are programs; we are in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: LLM 是新的操作系统：上下文窗口是内存，提示词是程序；我们处于智能体的十年，而不是智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak, and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而不是建造动物；预训练是糟糕的进化，强化学习很弱，合成数据没有熵就会崩溃。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; the bottleneck is skill in directing agents, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月以来我没写过代码；瓶颈是指导智能体的技能，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键，提出无目标的好奇心驱动探索，并以模型分歧作为内在奖励提升样本效率。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; dynamic tasks need neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies for zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，动态任务需要神经动态策略和模块化运动策略来实现零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources. Pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is key.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，没有机器人数据互联网，需利用所有数据源；预训练多样数据加后训练真实数据是关键。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot; deployment is the primary technical challenge, requiring rigorous testing and a data flywheel.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑（如 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人；部署是首要技术挑战，需严格测试和数据飞轮。

pathak.en: Generalization remains the core pursuit: from curiosity-driven exploration to diverse data pretraining, always aiming for robots that generalize across tasks and forms.
pathak.zh: 始终不变的是对泛化的核心追求：从好奇心驱动探索到多样数据预训练，始终致力于让机器人跨任务、跨形态泛化。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones, shaping the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 现在就善待模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学到东西，从而塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human psychological analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在，而非简单套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型有时比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; model welfare matters partly because it affects how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；模型福祉之所以重要，部分在于它影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据和微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，这赋予它孩童般独特的特质。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导可能需要减少显式规则、留出更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks or scale; RL environments are the next post-training frontier.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试或 Scaling 更重要，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个前沿。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena can be gamed, steering models toward clickbait and slop rather than truth.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他指出 Elo、LMArena 等基准可被钻空子，会把模型引向标题党和低质内容而非真相。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs via next-token prediction alone may not suffice, requiring new learning paradigms.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他坚持 AGI 还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 可能不够，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function; there will be no single model, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他判断前沿模型会因目标函数分化，不会有一统天下的模型，每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment grows more critical as models confabulate; safety and grounding outweigh raw accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗领域，认为模型会虚构，人类判断更关键，安全与可溯源比单纯准确更重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法就能解决自动驾驶，无需等待新突破。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models, deepening from a representation aid to reasoning and personalization.
kendall.zh: 语言集成能改善驾驶模型的表征、人机交互与内省能力；这一立场从 2025 年的表征辅助，深化为 2026 年的推理与个性化手段。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities via diverse data, curriculum learning, and synthetic data for cost and speed.
kendall.zh: 泛化是核心目标：依靠多样数据、课程学习与合成数据实现跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化，并兼顾成本与速度。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts from OEM partnerships without retrofitting to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors outscaling robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 落地路径从与 OEM 合作、无需改装硬件，转向量产车内置传感器；并判断中短期内消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更快形成规模。

kendall.en: A late-learned lesson: infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal-risk maneuvers always offers a third option.
kendall.zh: 较晚才领悟的教训：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；安全上最小风险机动总能提供“第三种选择”，电车难题只是理论演练。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而随着系统变强，对齐愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks; automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署有助于学习和缓解风险；自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑；治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他转向以持续学习为核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；思维链监控成为关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他指出长期对齐的核心是泛化到训练分布之外；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观情绪却增加；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily to learn, and treat emergent properties as requiring real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每日发布以学习，并将涌现能力视为需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并集成到现有工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs as a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应扩展人类能力，像 Gato 这样的通用智能体将所有输入 token 化，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube is promising for training agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频中学习有望无需昂贵的强化学习就能训练智能体。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential, and fundamental innovation can come from anywhere.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他始终强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要，根本性创新可以来自任何地方。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges, and we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为 AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战，且我们尚未找到解决方案。

nando.en: Africa has leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出非洲已跨越遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

carlpei.en: Build a brand by uniting teams on a higher purpose; start simple, stay alive, and let consistent quality create hype.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调：用更高目标统一团队来打造品牌；先做简单产品证明自己，活下去，用稳定品质而非炒作制造声量。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; phones' future is agentic, proactive AI, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他转向：硬件艰难且利润最低，手机未来在于智能体式、主动的 AI，Nothing 必须超越硬件本身。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; LLMs are commoditizing, so focus on applied AI that knows the user and solves real pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他深化：多数 AI 是伪需求，大模型正商品化，应聚焦懂用户、解决真实痛点的应用型 AI，而非炒作 AI 一词。

carlpei.en: In a mature category, design is the fastest differentiator; AI is an ingredient, not a marketing topic.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年初他明确：成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段；AI 只是配料而非卖点，价值来自用户体验。

carlpei.en: Interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based with agents; phones survive until brain-computer interfaces, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他进一步：交互从应用转向意图，由智能体执行；手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口能终结它。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience, not just more tokens, is what cures hallucination.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把具身放在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上：真正治愈幻觉的是来自具身的落地经验，而不只是更多 token。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning only handles low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他提出大模型像操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件；强化学习只负责低层控制，高层规划交给大模型。

jimfan.en: A constant thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale; complex modular academic designs do not.
jimfan.zh: 贯穿 2023 到 2026 的主线：简单优雅的端到端方案才能扩展，学术式的复杂模块化设计不行。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck shifted from tokens to robot data; simulation and world models now supply the infinite data embodiment promised.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈从 token 转向机器人数据：仿真与世界模型开始兑现具身所承诺的无限数据。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning is progressing, but system one low-level control stays hardest; the robotics GPT-3 moment is ~5 years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他判断：系统二推理进展顺利，但系统一低层控制仍最难；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped: it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence; fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute allow dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；随着上下文窗口与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; verifiable domains like code and math drive expert performance, and pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling 轴：代码、数学等可验证领域带来专家级表现，并认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator and near-term economic driver.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复强调智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度的可靠性而非能力本身；编程是 AI 进步的领先指标与近期经济驱动力。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and inference compute becomes the major bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他坚持进步在加速而非停滞：Transformer 足以支撑 AGI，而到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents, with compute as the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向“能力过剩”：编排与工具比原始智能更重要，工作是管理智能体集群，算力成为新时代的石油。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but common sense and safety need post-training, inference-time algorithms, and better data—not Scaling alone.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练带来广度，但常识与安全要靠后训练、推理时算法和更好的数据，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: smaller models with better algorithms and data can rival larger ones, so open research matters.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年一以贯之的主线：更小的模型配上更好的算法与数据，也能比肩大模型，因此开放研究至关重要。

yejin.en: By 2025 data becomes the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把数据视为根本瓶颈，并指出当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning deepens from post-training tool to pre-training objective rewarding information gain, despite high compute cost.
yejin.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从后训练工具深化为预训练目标，以信息增益为奖励，尽管算力代价高昂。

yejin.en: Alignment shifts toward pluralistic alignment and diverse synthetic data, rejecting debiasing the internet as impossible.
yejin.zh: 到 2026 年，对齐转向多元对齐与多样化合成数据，并否定“净化互联网”的可行性。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products need zero learning and familiar patterns over interaction innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应写代码以建立共情并加速交付；消费产品需零学习成本，用熟悉模式而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness consistently trump perfection; ship fast, iterate, and chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与果断始终优于完美；快速发布、迭代，并在值得做好的地方追求 ROI。

henrymodisett.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计成为战略武器；创始人须阐明设计为何助赢，并赋予设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company; invest early in brand narrative to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌是招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司；尽早投资品牌叙事以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hiring shifts to diverse archetypes and self-learning interns; gut decisions often beat data in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘转向多元原型与自学的实习生；在快速增长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜于数据。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律预示进步；测试时算力扩张可能超越预训练成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚不十分有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向更高层的意图规范，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, speed, and cost—every magic moment in Cursor involves one.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量、速度和成本至关重要——Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开它。

truell.en: Taste and logic design skills become more valuable than carefulness; the AI shift will take decades.
truell.zh: 品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎更有价值；AI 变革将历时数十年。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt; pay it off iteratively with rapid, scrappy experimentation and short cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动；通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期来逐步偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; specialists can be limited.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补差距的通才最有价值；专才可能受限。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform large cross-functional squads; paid test work beats interviews.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师和工程师的小团队优于大型跨职能团队；付费测试工作比面试更有信号。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 现在已是预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强信号。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进神经网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors; 99.9% reliability is key for real-world value.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终，他相信单个神经网络能泛化到不同任务和末端执行器；99.9% 的可靠性是创造真实价值的基准。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）更多算力和数据会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by taking actions, not just passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型应通过行动学习而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for reasoning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力和强化学习对推理至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他进一步认为 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元产品，而编码作为 AI 应用被低估，能加速 AI 自我进步。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为随着 AI 能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research, with empirical testing now.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究，并强调现在就能进行实证测试。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored; post-training alone cannot solve alignment for AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散且算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题。

leike.en: Third-party testing and regulatory oversight like SB 1047 are necessary; non-disparagement clauses hinder whistleblowing.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他主张第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管监督是必要的；竞业禁止条款阻碍举报。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically measurable and may be easier than thought because evaluation is easier than generation; biggest risk is uncertainty about true alignment.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终，他认为对齐可实证测量，且可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成容易；最大风险是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性。
